items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 3:15:1
items.html:
Only the three lower ones could be clothed: This matter came about in the world of Nekudim, by force of the important correction of joining the attribute of mercy with judgment, as written (in the Ohr Pnimi, Chapter 10, Item 1), namely that the point of Malchut, which is phase four, ascended together with the screen in her to the bottom of Bina, and phase two was fixed as the phase of the screen and the point of conclusion; and by reason of this new conclusion, phase three and phase four, which comprise the ten Sefirot of the general phase four, went out and separated, because they are found in the secret of the aforementioned new restriction and cannot receive the upper light within them, and therefore they must receive the upper light from a distance, in the secret of surrounding lights. And phase three separated from the Partzuf and became the phase of a vessel for the surrounding light, called garment, which is a vessel for the surrounding light of the light of Hochma, called Haya. And phase four, which separated from the Partzuf, became the phase of a palace, which is a vessel for the surrounding light of the light of Keter, called Yechida. And this matter is brought above in the words of the ARI (Chapter 10, Item 1) — see there.
And this is what the ARI writes here: "and not all five kinds of soul could be clothed, only the three lower ones alone, namely Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama; and for these alone there were vessels and bodies corresponding to them, but Haya and Yechida of every Partzuf have no vessels in that very Partzuf in which to be clothed; rather, they remain outside without vessels, in the secret of surrounding," end of quote — that is, as clarified, and what he wrote, that they remained outside without vessels, means without inner vessels, because they became vessels for the surrounding light called garment and palace, as clarified.
And one should not object that since only the lower vessels separated, namely phase three, which is ZA, and phase four, which is Malchut, then the lights of Ruach and Nefesh should have remained without vessels and become surrounding lights, since these are the ones attributed to phase three and phase four — so why did Haya and Yechida remain without vessels, when their vessels, Keter and Hochma, remained in the Partzuf? Indeed you already know the opposite relation between bestowal, which is the drawing of the light to the Partzuf, and the vessel of reception of the light in the Partzuf. As the ARI has taught us, whoever bestows, bestows through the coarsest thing, and whoever receives must receive through the most refined thing. And this matter has already been clarified above (in the Ohr Pnimi, Chapter 11, Item 3, Sub Header, "From the ear," and in the Inner Observation, Part 2, Chapter 8 — see there the whole passage).
And it has been clarified there that the expansion of Ein Sof, blessed be He, to make vessels, is called bestowal to the Partzuf. And it is known that, for example, for the illumination of Yechida to shine, the expansion of the light of Ein Sof must meet the screen of phase four, that is, the coarsest thing, so that then, by the striking of the light, reflected light ascends and clothes up to Keter, which is the light of Yechida, as above; but if there is not, in the degree, the coarseness of the aforesaid phase four, but only the coarseness of phase three, then the expansion of the light of Ein Sof, blessed be He, striking upon the screen, raises reflected light only in a measure that attains and clothes up to the level of Haya alone — so that for the bestowal of the light, the coarsest phase in the degree is required.
Indeed the reception of the light drawn in the manner mentioned is the opposite; for although the light of Yechida is bestowed only through the coarsest thing, which is phase four, nevertheless that light of Yechida cannot be clothed there except in the most refined thing in the degree, namely only in the vessel of Keter; and likewise the light of Haya bestowed through phase three is not clothed there except in phase one, which is the most refined thing in that same degree, and so always.
And accordingly it is found clarified that, by reason of the separation of phase three and phase four from the Partzuf, which became distant and turned into surrounding lights, as above, from this cause the one who bestows can no longer bestow to the Partzuf either the light of Yechida or the light of Haya, because to bestow the light of Yechida he needs phase four, and to bestow the light of Haya he needs phase three, and these have already separated from the Partzuf and are no longer there, as above. Here you see plainly that from this point on, the light of Yechida and the light of Haya are hidden from the Partzuf, for the reason that phase three and phase four separated and are no more.
It is also understood that the garment, which is a surrounding vessel from phase three, is the surrounding light of the phase of Haya, for it is the light that became distant and hidden by reason of its concealment from the Partzuf, as above, and therefore it now shines from a distance in the phase of surrounding. And likewise it is understood that the palace became the surrounding light of the light of Yechida, for this is the light that was hidden together with phase four, at the time of its concealment from the Partzuf, so that it must shine from a distance in the phase of surrounding.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 3:15:2
items.html: As though it were separated: Because it is the direct way of the light to expand always even into phase four, were it not for the screen there that restrains it. And this is what is meant by "as though it were separated," for everything received in phase four is regarded as separated from the Emanator by reason of the disparity of form that is in phase four.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 3:15:3
items.html: Squaring: Squaring means that the letters of the Name, namely the five phases in the screen that is in the vessel of Malchut, come and join and become hidden one within another, the letters hinting at the five phases of the refinement of the screen: at first the level of Keter is revealed, which is the secret of the Alef of Elokim; and when it is refined from phase four to phase three, only the level of Hochma is revealed, which is the secret of the Lamed, and Keter is hidden and clothed within the level of Hochma, and they become Al. And when it is refined to phase two, only the level of Bina is revealed, which is the secret of the Hey, and it is found that the Lamed too, which is Hochma, is clothed within Bina, and they become Aleh. And when it is refined to phase one, only the level of ZA is revealed, which is the secret of the Yud, and Keter, Hochma and Bina are found clothed in ZA, and they become Elohi. And when it is refined to its root entirely, which is the secret of the Mem, Keter, Hochma, Bina and ZA are found hidden and joined in this Mem, and they become Elokim.
